name: lbrce-ai
description: LBRCE AI — retrieval-grounded assistant for Lakireddy Bali Reddy College of Engineering

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @lbrce/api" "npm run dev -w @lbrce/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @lbrce/shared && npm run build -w @lbrce/api && npm run build -w @lbrce/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @lbrce/shared && npm run typecheck -w @lbrce/api && npm run typecheck -w @lbrce/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @lbrce/shared && npm run test -w @lbrce/api && npm run test -w @lbrce/web
